{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# If there are any, they would appear as '1,234.56' — let's check for commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many rows have commas
comma_count = has_commas.sum()
print(f"Number of rows with commas in 'revenue': {comma_count}")

# Also check if any have non-numeric characters
non_numeric = sales['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.,]', na=False)
non_numeric_count = non_numeric.sum()
print(f"Number of rows with non-numeric characters in 'revenue': {non_numeric_count}")"}
